parties: Jana Small Finance Bank Limited; Federal Bank Limited (alleged)
headline: NSE seeks clarification from Jana Small Finance Bank on merger buzz reports
sum: **NSE issued a clarification request to Jana Small Finance Bank** regarding recent news reports of a potential merger with Federal Bank; company response awaited.
implication: Unverified merger rumors can trigger stock volatility and NSE disclosure obligations; companies must promptly respond to exchange queries on market-sensitive allegations.
detail: NSE sought clarification from Jana Small Finance Bank concerning recent news captioned 'Jana Small Finance Bank, Federal Bank shares fall up to 4% amid merger buzz.' The exchange explicitly notes that the company's response is awaited, indicating the news remains unconfirmed. This is a standard NSE transparency protocol when material rumors circulate.
